status_rationale: Repaired remaining MAJOR blocker by adding boolean false to the false-iff falsy partition while preserving repaired default-branch coverage and total-class partitioning scope.

unit.scope_boundary: Only ToBoolean value-coercion behavior for ECMAScript language values, including the B.3.6.1 [[IsHTMLDDA]] replacement branch. No runtime/memory/host model state is in scope.

compliance_notes: No proofs are included in this stage.
All theorem names are unit-specific and tied to namespace Spec2Lean.ECMAScript.ToBoolean.
The false-iff theorem was strengthened to include the false-Boolean falsy constructor case to match branch semantics.

theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For every Boolean value b, ToBoolean on EcmaValue.boolean returns the same boolean bit value.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_boolean_identity (b : EcmaBoolean) : ToBoolean (EcmaValue.boolean b) = toBooleanBool b

theorem_obligations.intent: Explicit falsy primitive constants are false in ToBoolean.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: ToBoolean returns false on undefined, null, +0, -0, NaN, 0n, and empty string, matching the clause-defined falsy literals.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_falsy_primitive_cases : ToBoolean EcmaValue.undefined = false ∧ ToBoolean EcmaValue.null = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.number EcmaNumber.posZero) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.number EcmaNumber.negZero) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.number EcmaNumber.nan) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.bigInt 0) = false ∧ ToBoolean (EcmaValue.string "") = false
theorem_obligations.conclusion: The listed primitive falsy values evaluate to false.

theorem_obligations.intent: If the object argument has the [[IsHTMLDDA]] slot, ToBoolean returns false per the B.3.6.1 replacement.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: For any object value o marked hasIsHTMLDDA, ToBoolean of EcmaValue.object o is false.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_object_isHTMLDDA_falsey_branch (o : EcmaObject) (h : o.hasIsHTMLDDA = true) : ToBoolean (EcmaValue.object o) = false

theorem_obligations.intent: Every non-falsy value class reaches the default truthy branch.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: If an argument is constructor-wise truthy according to the remaining cases (true boolean, non-falsy number, non-zero BigInt, non-empty string, any symbol, or object with [[IsHTMLDDA]] = false), then ToBoolean returns true.
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_truthy_default_branch (argument : EcmaValue) : (argument = EcmaValue.boolean EcmaBoolean.true ∨ (∃ n, argument = EcmaValue.number n ∧ numberIsFalsy n = false) ∨ (∃ z, argument = EcmaValue.bigInt z ∧ z ≠ 0) ∨ (∃ s, argument = EcmaValue.string s ∧ stringIsFalsy s = false) ∨ (∃ o, argument = EcmaValue.object o ∧ o.hasIsHTMLDDA = false) ∨ (∃ sym, argument = EcmaValue.symbol sym)) → ToBoolean argument = true
theorem_obligations.conclusion: In all non-falsy classes, ToBoolean argument = true.

theorem_obligations.intent: Characterize exactly when ToBoolean yields false, using the clause-defined falsy and web-compat cases.
theorem_obligations.precise_statement_in_words: ToBoolean returns false exactly for false, undefined, null, NaN/±0, BigInt 0, empty string, and objects marked [[IsHTMLDDA]].
theorem_obligations.lean_statement_sketch: theorem toBoolean_false_iff_falsy_cases (argument : EcmaValue) : ToBoolean argument = false ↔ (argument = EcmaValue.boolean EcmaBoolean.false ∨ argument = EcmaValue.undefined ∨ argument = EcmaValue.null ∨ (∃ n, argument = EcmaValue.number n ∧ numberIsFalsy n) ∨ (∃ z, argument = EcmaValue.bigInt z ∧ z = 0) ∨ (∃ s, argument = EcmaValue.string s ∧ stringIsFalsy s) ∨ (∃ o, argument = EcmaValue.object o ∧ o.hasIsHTMLDDA = true))
theorem_obligations.conclusion: ToBoolean argument = false exactly on the falsy and [[IsHTMLDDA]] object cases.
